rule: Actions that produce external effects declare a recall window. Countdowns are visible and cancelable.

ux.announcement: aria-live=polite at start; no re-announce on every tick

refusal: Recall without a visible countdown — users don't know the window exists.
Recall requiring navigation to a separate 'Undo' screen — undermines the affordance.
Recall window > 5 minutes for actions with external observers (stale window misleads initiator).
